'''Poz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] agent of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]] Poz was stationed at the [[Meltwater Outpost]] in the [[High Security Section]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], where she investigated the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] teleportation technology and theorized that the teleporters might not be capable of actual matter transmission but instead replicating matter of a subject or even perhaps functioned as fixed dimensional pathways. As the possibilities were infinite, Poz dubbed them ''"Instantaneous Travel Device"'' and tracked the Esh-kha who were controlling the teleporter to an older vault.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Agent Poz appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Belsavis, involved in the planetary bonus series of quests.
